body.x: Amo Lab has presented its wearable device for sleep improvement AMO+ in 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT'(BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

The device AMO+ which is being introduced in CES 2019 quickly recovers balance in autonomic nerves by stimulating the sympathetic nerves and improves the quality of sleep by reducing stress and stabilizing heart rate and respiration.
This device can really help people who suffer from sleep disorder due to a lack of time and stress to to get decent sleep.

In addition, the device is a non-contact bioelectronic medicine that not only restores sleep but also helps chronic diseases associated with aging, while restoring health. "A final goal of Amo Lab is to research and develop technologies that can significantly extend human life span," Amo Lab official said.

Amo Lab will launch its products in the global market in early 2019. Currently, Taiwan and Japan distributors have been confirmed, and meetings on sales or collaboration with many global distribution channels such as Johnson & Johnson (Sweden), OURA (Finland), P&G (Belgium), Ogawa Group (China), LG U+ are on the way. After summer of 2019, sales in Europe and Southeast Asia are expected to be generated.
